style: Smug, slow, sassy greeting, like a best friend about to roast you. A little drawn out.

text: You did your fucking challenge, right?
Five days live. Voice: dead. Ring light: still on.
style: Deadpan and mocking, short punchy beats with tiny pauses.

text: And now, four hundred people in your DMs like... "info?"
style: Building up, then a whiny, high-pitched mocking imitation on 'info?'.

text: And you answer them... by hand? At midnight? In bed?
style: Disbelief, getting more outraged with each question.

text: That's not a business. That's a hostage situation.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and dramatic.
Cool and confident, a swagger switch.

text: I learn your offer, I talk like you, I handle the "I'll think about it"... and I book the call. In your calendar.
style: Fast, confident and rhythmic, like listing flexes.

text: You? Go to sleep. You look like shit.
style: Teasing, affectionate roast with comedic timing.

text: Comment SETTY. I'll slide into your DMs.
style: Smooth, smug, a little flirty sign-off.
